_why: The whole of SISO as projects > sub-projects > the agent that owns each, kept by Agent Zero (ADR 0002: it keeps the data). bin/siso-map renders it with live state, cards and each owner's queue; Agent Base's side nav reads the same data once t-0562/t-0563 land. Shaan, 8 Oct ~22:10: "SISO agency is like a main project, it's an agency, and then inside there you've got the agent base, you've got the landing page ... I can kind of use this website to kind of plan out all of my shit"; ~22:25: "let's make our base, this app, this site, the back end, figure out how this all fits together, the estate, it needs to be fitted together and reasoned and put in a way where I can see it and we can work with it and improve it".

projects.name: SISO Agency
projects.what: The agency: the main project. Everything public ships under it.

subs.name: SISO Site
subs.what: siso.agency: the five products, SISO OS, the showcase for the Claude partners application; subdomains per product, module, industry, blog, library.

subs.name: Agent Base (SISO OS)
subs.what: The app he lives in; open-sourced as SISO OS (core + swappable modules). One Opus on the Mac mini with Haiku helpers, one branch, lands everything. AB-ASTRA (Astra, since 9 Oct 05:15) builds the specced asks on astra/<t-id> branches for it to land.

subs.name: UI Hub
subs.what: Our own 21st.dev (ADR 0007): 21st.dev's structure filled with our catalogue (1,182 items, his 138 picks), bookmarks, shells, layouts, tools; agents use it by CLI and MCP; a SISO OS module. Owners: UI-DESIGN (long-running Opus, the look and integration, since 9 Oct 06:15) and UI-HUB (Astra: previews, speed, libraries, deploys, until Codex runs out).

subs.name: Sites and the claim engine
subs.paused: tabled by Shaan, 8 Oct: let it cook
subs.what: Free sites for businesses on Google Maps (a million by end of 2026, inbound only).

subs.name: SISO Voice
subs.what: Its own MIT app and a SISO OS module (the user's own Groq key); the helper runs as launchd com.siso.agent-base.voice on the laptop. VOICE, a long-running Opus on the Mac mini since 9 Oct 06:05 (Shaan: "a world class voice app"), owns it; AGENT-BASE lands.

helpers.name: IMAGE-GEN
helpers.what: Image generation (Astra fanning out Luna): a couple of images per industry, a shared set, client heroes and footers; took over from IMAGE-BRAIN 9 Oct 00:05.

helpers.name: MERCH
helpers.what: Goal agent (Astra), 9 Oct 02:20: merch images for the SISO site's 'merch coming soon' (hoodies, tees, a knit runner, a skeleton watch, all with the real lion mark); hands picks to SISO-LANDING, then stops.

helpers.name: LANDING-ART
helpers.what: Goal agent (Astra), 9 Oct 03:20: the last of Codex's week on the SISO site's images (the 13 GEN-IMAGE slots, OG cards, the second half of the industry sets beside IMAGE-GEN); stops when Codex refuses.

subs.name: HALO base (CRM)
subs.what: The whole HALO base: CRM, Discord, sheets, the VPS. Its own owner is wanted (Shaan, 22:58).

subs.name: Streaming
subs.what: The specialised owner inside HALO base.

projects.name: Research
projects.what: A standalone department: agents with every search tool (GitHub, X, YouTube, search APIs) mapping domains into the Foundry (ADR 0006). One per question, spun up and down.

projects.name: Infrastructure
projects.what: What keeps the machines, the data and the agents working.

subs.name: Agent Zero
subs.what: Turns his words into outcomes; keeps this map, the asks and the owners' state.

subs.name: Estate
subs.what: Both machines: 100 GB free each, data security, nothing kept that isn't needed.

subs.name: Efficiency
subs.what: Token spend that renews: work kept, windows not burnt.

subs.name: Great Library
subs.what: Everything we know, in one reader, on a private Cloudflare Worker.

projects.name: Playground
projects.what: Any agent that fits no project: his experiments, and anything not yet placed (t-0562's reconciler puts unknown agents here, never a guess).
